properties.tributary_system: Upper Bhima (Mula-Mutha, Pavana, Indrayani, Ghod, Kukadi, Nira, Man)
properties.key_reservoirs: Mulshi, Pawna, Khadakwasla, Panshet, Warasgaon, Chasakman, Bhama Askhed, Yedgaon, Bhatghar, Nira Deoghar, Vir, Ujjani
properties.interbasin_notes: Westward Tata Power hydropower diversion from Mulshi/Andhra (~0.42 BCM/yr export); major Pune Metro urban/industrial hub

properties.tributary_system: Mainstem Upper Krishna (Koyna, Warna, Panchganga, Dudhganga, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha)
properties.key_reservoirs: Koyna, Dhom, Kanher, Warna, Radhanagari, Hidkal (Ghataprabha), Naviluteertha (Malaprabha), Almatti, Narayanpur
properties.interbasin_notes: Westward hydropower diversion from Koyna Dam to Pophali/Konkan (~1.95 BCM/yr export to Arabian Sea)

properties.tributary_system: Upper Tungabhadra (Tunga, Bhadra, Kumudvathi, Varada, Haridra)
properties.interbasin_notes: High-rainfall Western Ghats headwaters (Agumbe/Kudremukh); Upper Bhadra lift project transfers toward Vedavathi

properties.key_reservoirs: Sina, Bori, Amarja, Kagna, Bhima Lift Irrigation (Sannati)
properties.interbasin_notes: Receives regulated Ujjani outflow and Sina inter-subbasin link; joins Krishna mainstem near Kadlur (Raichur/Yadgir)

properties.key_reservoirs: Vanivilasa Sagar, Sunkesula Barrage, Rajolibanda Diversion (RDS), Gajuladinne, Gollapalli/HNSS storage
properties.interbasin_notes: Semi-arid rain-shadow core; exports via Tungabhadra HLC/LLC and Handri-Neeva Sujala Sravanti (HNSS) toward Pennar/Rayalaseema

properties.tributary_system: Middle Krishna Mainstem (Narayanpur to Srisailam backwaters, Peddavagu, Dindi upstream)
properties.key_reservoirs: Priyadarshini Jurala, Koilsagar, Ramanpad, Narayanpur Left/Right Bank Command
properties.interbasin_notes: Receives KRI_UPPER (Narayanpur releases) and BHI_LOWER (Bhima confluence); feeds Kalwakurthy/Nettempadu/Bhima lifts

properties.tributary_system: Lower Krishna & Delta (Dindi, Musi, Halia, Palair, Munneru, Wyra, Kattaleru)
properties.key_reservoirs: Srisailam, Nagarjuna Sagar, Pulichintala (K.L. Rao Sagar), Prakasam Barrage, Osmansagar, Himayatsagar, Musi, Palair, Wyra
properties.interbasin_notes: Exports via Pothireddypadu/SRBC/Telugu Ganga to Pennar/Chennai (~2.2-3.5 BCM/yr); imports Godavari water via Pattiseema Lift into Prakasam Barrage since 2015-16 (~1.5-3.0 BCM/yr); includes Hyderabad Metro & Musi wastewater return flows
